sentences.text: The home loan agreement states a ₹500 per month charge for each month of default, and it labels that item as a penal charge.
For this UCB, penal interest is not permitted, and any penalty for non-compliance must be treated as penal charges rather than interest added to the rate of interest.

On the evidence provided, the agreement does not show that the ₹500 monthly charge is being added to the interest rate, so the documents do not establish a violation of the RBI prohibition on penal interest.
What is not shown in the evidence is whether this charge is applied in any other way than as a penal charge, so that point remains unverified.

missing.searched: Checked the home loan agreement for whether the charge is added to the rate of interest or otherwise levied as penal interest; the document only states 'Penal charge ₹500 per month of default'.
